description: A low cave mouth ringed with claw marks; something large sleeps further in.
A heap of bones and trinkets left for whatever rules the den.
Standing stones under open sky where the pack keeps watch at night.
Old stonework split apart by roots and choked with vines.
Brambles close overhead and the light turns green and dim.
A valley drowned in flowers, humming with insects.
Every turn looks like the last one. The path has been walked many times.
Walls of clipped hedge run straight for a while, then do not.
Two great mirrors face each other; your reflection is a beat too slow.
A rocky ledge over still water, wrapped in cold fog.
Waist-high reeds hide the waterline and whatever moves beneath it.
A basin that fills and empties with an unseen tide.
Blue-lit vents bubble up through the pool floor.
Names and dates are carved all around a deep, clear pool.
A dripping grotto lit by glowing mites on the ceiling.
Water runs in channels along a vaulted nave toward the altar.
The temple forecourt sits ankle-deep in seawater.
A throne sunk to its armrests; something still sits on it.
Charred trunks stand in rows like burnt matches.
Smoke pools along the ceiling; breathing low is the only option.
A ridge of black stone, still warm, under a sky of drifting ash.
A narrow bridge over a moat of slow-moving lava.
A throne of blackened gold before a wall of fire.
Tapestries burn without ever turning to ash.
A buried city sealed in amber-colored glass.
Lava wells up from below and spills in glowing channels.
Islands of cooled slag float on a lake of molten rock.
Wind-carved dunes roll to the horizon under a white sun.
Sand fused into sheets of glass that throw back the glare.
A ring of palms around clear water, the only shade for miles.
Torn tents and a cold fire pit; whoever camped here left in a hurry.
A thin ledge above a long drop and a hard wind.
The top of the world, thin of air and loud with wind.
Sarcophagi line the walls; one lid is not quite closed.
A long sloping corridor lined with painted gods.
A sealed door, recently unsealed.
Contained spells and magical artifacts line the walls, their power barely contained.
Arcane symbols glow on the walls, and the air crackles with magical energy.
Books float in mid-air, and magical instruments hum with contained power.
A chamber where entire galaxies seem to swirl in miniature, their light casting dancing shadows.
Astronomical instruments point toward swirling clouds of cosmic dust and energy.
The ceiling is a map of the cosmos, with stars that actually twinkle and move.
Broken pillars and fallen stones litter the floor of this once-grand chamber.
Ancient stone walls lined with burial niches, the air thick with dust and decay.
Time has taken its toll on this room, leaving only fragments of its former glory.
A weathered altar stands among the ruins, still radiating ancient power.
A forgotten tomb where the walls are covered in ancient hieroglyphs.
A beautiful chamber where crystals grow in intricate formations.
A massive geode has been cracked open, revealing its crystalline interior.
The walls seem to shimmer and shift, making it difficult to determine what's real.
Endless waves of sand stretch in all directions, shifting with the hot desert winds.
Reality tears apart at the seams, revealing glimpses of other worlds beyond.
Infinite versions of this room exist simultaneously, each slightly different from the others.
The laws of physics break down here, creating impossible geometries and paradoxical spaces.
A place where mortals can commune with the divine, surrounded by angelic choirs.
Time has no meaning in this hallowed space, where the divine presence is eternal.
Divine light fills this sacred space, radiating peace and overwhelming power.
Reality bends and shifts in this realm where dreams and nightmares take physical form.
A space where consciousness and dreams merge, offering clarity in the chaos.
The deepest recesses of the mind manifest as a twisting maze of thoughts and memories.
Massive trees tower overhead, their branches forming a natural cathedral.
A deep cave entrance with claw marks on the walls and the smell of wild animals.
A peaceful clearing in the woods, dappled with sunlight.
Crystal-clear water bubbles from the earth, surrounded by lush vegetation.
Ancient trees form a natural cathedral, their branches intertwining overhead.
A carpet of colorful flowers stretches as far as the eye can see, filling the air with sweet perfume.
A natural cave where wolves have made their home. Bones and fur litter the ground.
Weapons and armor are displayed on racks and stands.
A grand chamber, clearly the domain of a powerful being. The walls are adorned with trophies of past conquests.
A long table set for a feast, though the food looks... questionable.
A large, imposing entrance to the dungeon. The air is thick with anticipation.
A well-fortified position, manned by vigilant guards.
A large cooking area, with pots and pans hanging from the ceiling.
Rows of ancient tomes and scrolls fill this room.
Ancient mechanisms and cryptic symbols cover the walls.
A surprisingly peaceful area, with comfortable furnishings.
Shelves and crates line the walls, filled with supplies.
The floor is suspiciously clean, and the walls have strange markings.
A room filled with glittering gold and precious artifacts. But is it too good to be true?
Ice crystals hang from the ceiling like chandeliers, and your breath forms clouds in the frigid air.
A perfectly still lake frozen solid, with strange shapes visible beneath the ice.
A vast chamber carved from solid ice, with frozen waterfalls cascading down the walls.
The walls glow red-hot, and the air shimmers with intense heat.
Molten rock flows through channels in the floor, creating an oppressive heat.
Molten rock bubbles and churns in a vast underground lake of fire.
A bubbling pool of molten rock with steam rising from its surface.
A narrow passage where superheated gases escape from deep underground.
Superheated gases escape through cracks in the rock, creating an oppressive atmosphere.
A peaceful clearing high in the mountains, surrounded by snow-capped peaks.
The highest point offers a breathtaking view, but the thin air makes breathing difficult.
Jagged rocks and boulders create a treacherous landscape of stone and shadow.
The crushing pressure of the deep ocean creates an otherworldly atmosphere.
Vibrant coral formations create a natural underwater garden of incredible beauty.
Coral formations and sea creatures create a beautiful underwater landscape.
Darkness seems to have substance here, swirling and moving with malevolent intent.
A sacred space where shadows gather, pulsing with otherworldly energy.
Brass instruments and mechanical contraptions line the walls, ticking in perfect harmony.
Enormous interlocking gears create a maze of moving metal, each turn revealing new dangers.
Massive gears and pistons churn endlessly, filling the air with the sound of industry.
A circular chamber where winds spiral upward, creating a vortex of air and debris.
Winds howl through the room, carrying the scent of rain and ozone.
Lightning crackles through the air, illuminating the chamber with brilliant flashes.
A small dry patch in the endless swamp, surrounded by murky water and twisted trees.
An ancient stone circle rises from the swamp, offering a moment of peace in the mire.
A bubbling pool of greenish liquid emits noxious fumes that make your eyes water.
An ancient altar where the faithful once gathered for worship.
Ancient clocks and hourglasses mark the passage of time in this sacred space.
Sounds from the past echo through this chamber, creating a haunting symphony of memories.
The very fabric of time seems unstable here, with moments from past and future overlapping.
A narrow passage carved through solid rock, with the sound of dripping water echoing endlessly.
Abandoned tools and carts litter the ground, evidence of long-forgotten industry.
A vast underground chamber with stone pillars supporting the weight of the earth above.
A vast chamber where the absence of everything creates a profound sense of peace.
A space that defies description, where the very concept of 'room' seems inadequate.
An empty space where light itself seems to be consumed by the surrounding darkness.
An empty space where nothing exists, not even the concept of existence itself.
